title: Questify: quests no longer auto-complete
description: User report (2026-11-24): the Questify plugin (src/plugins/questify, ported from Equicord in 42666b42) does not auto-complete quests. Investigate src/plugins/questify/utils/completion.ts against current Discord builds and Equicord's questify source; fix the root cause.
acceptance_criteria: Enrolled quests of supported task types progress and complete automatically when auto-complete is enabled; pnpm build --dev and pnpm test pass.
notes: Merged upstream/main (ce9355e9) cleanly; build passes. Fork completion.ts is identical to Equicord main (8d63e96) except expiry sort; index.tsx lacks Equicord 65c35782 (quest tile patch fixes) and 894a2edb (claim deadlines). Running scripts/generateReport.ts (pnpm buildReporter + esbuild -> dist/report.mjs, CHROMIUM_BIN=Edge) against stable+canary to find broken Questify patches/finds. Auto-complete gate: isAutoCompleteRuntimeReady() needs both stack-trace patches (QUESTS_VIDEO_PROGRESS / heartbeat) to apply.
close_reason: Patch reporter (stable+canary, Discord desktop 1.0.9269) showed Questify's only broken patches were the Quest tile group (module 'questNameHeadingId': useQuestRerender subscription + tile classes) after Discord wrapped the tile in a context .Provider and added a third classnames arg; group:true reverted the whole group, freezing tile re-renders (completion countdown/status). Ported Equicord 65c35782 regexes; reporter now shows zero Questify failures on stable and canary. Stack-trace/heartbeat/video-progress/enroll patches and finds all match the current build; runtime probe: canAutoCompleteQuest true with WATCH_VIDEO enabled (button 'Complete (01:00)'), false with types disabled. User's live settings (%APPDATA%/Vencord/settings/settings.json) have allowChangingDangerousSettings=false and every autoCompleteQuestTypes entry false, so nothing auto-completes until they opt in; README now documents the opt-in path. pnpm test and pnpm build --dev pass. Real quest credit not verifiable without an account session.

title: Enable fork automatic update releases
description: Standalone builds of logixism/Vencord use the existing upstream HTTP updater, but the fork has no releases because the inherited build workflow only publishes for Vendicated/Vencord. Restore publication of updater-compatible devbuild releases for this fork without changing its update source to upstream.
acceptance_criteria: The main-branch workflow supports initial release creation and subsequent asset replacement, manual dispatch, release-write permissions, and serialized publishing. Desktop and web standalone builds succeed. Native updater detection and installation work with published assets for both Discord and Vesktop. Document standalone versus Git updater behavior.
close_reason: Fixed .github/workflows/build.yml to publish updater-compatible devbuild releases for the fork, bootstrap the first release, enable main-only manual runs, grant contents write, and serialize publications. Preserved the upstream-only builds mirror and documented fork updates in README.md. Desktop/web standalone builds and plugin metadata generation passed. Real gh CLI against an isolated HTTPS release API fixture successfully created and replaced releases; the actual native updater reproduced the pre-publication 404, then installed 10 assets byte-for-byte for each Discord/Vesktop target and reported no update for the current build. Fixture stopped and removed. No live release was published; deployment requires pushing the workflow to main.
